items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I'm sharing the bill with Nellie Lutcher. She will play half of the concert and I will play the other half of the concert.

ctx.x: And the fact of the matter is it was through her kindness, and through an act of kindness of the musician's union that this was arranged for me as a means of my getting back into music after my operation, and being heard and seen again. And so I'm sharing the bill with Nellie Lutcher. She will play half of the concert and I will play the other half of the concert.
